source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.6, printed page 309.

blocks.text: Stratosphere mein ozone ki concentration ka ghatna ozone ki kami (depletion) kehlata hai, jo chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) naami organic compounds se hui hai, jo kamre ke darja hararat par gases ya kam ubalne wale liquids hain aur aerosol propellants aur refrigerants ke taur par istemal hote hain. CFCs stratosphere mein phail jate hain, jahan ultraviolet shuaein unhen tor kar chlorine free radicals deti hain, jo ozone torte hain: CFCl3 UV se CFCl2 + Cl.; Cl. + O3 se ClO. + O2; ClO. + O se Cl. + O2. Aakhri qadam mein bana chlorine radical ek aur ozone molecule par hamla kar sakta hai, to doosra aur teesra qadam bohat baar dohraye jate hain: ek CFC molecule ka tootna ozone ke 100,000 molecules tak tabah kar sakta hai. CFCs fiza mein garmi rokne mein CO2 se 100,000 guna zyada moassar bhi hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne teesra qadam ClO. + O2 se Cl. + O2 chhapa hai, jo balanced nahi (oxygen ek atom zyada aur chlorine radical ka oxygen kahan gaya?). Sahi qadam ClO. + O se Cl. + O2 hai: oxygen atom (O) ClO. se oxygen chheen kar O2 banata hai aur Cl. azad ho kar dobara ozone torta hai.

blocks.prompt: CFCs aur ozone ki tah ki kami par mukhtasar note likhein (exercise Q.4i; MCQ II, VI).
blocks.explanation: CFCs, jo kabhi refrigerants aur aerosol propellants ke taur par aam the, itne ghair-reactive hain ke bach kar stratosphere tak pohnch jate hain, jahan ultraviolet roshni C-Cl bond tor kar chlorine radical chhorti hai. Radical ozone ko oxygen mein badalta hai aur jab ClO radical oxygen atom se milta hai to dobara ban jata hai, to ek chlorine atom bar bar ozone molecules tabah karta hai, fi CFC molecule 100,000 tak, us tah ko patla karte hue jo satah ko ultraviolet se bachati hai.

items: CFCs (propellants, refrigerants) stratosphere tak pohnchte hain; UV Cl. radicals azad karti hai; Cl. + O3 se ClO. + O2 aur ClO. + O se Cl. + O2, dohrate hue: ek CFC molecule 100,000 ozone molecules tabah kar sakta hai; taqatwar greenhouse gases bhi.
